name: Popup
description: A card in your note that opens another note as a popup. Type // on an empty line and choose Popup, pick a note (or type a new name to create one), then tap the card: on the phone the note slides up over the page you are on, on the desktop it opens in the other half of a split view. If the note is renamed or moved inside Granite the card follows it. Stored as plain text.
tagline: Type // to link a note that opens as a popup
author: Granite
